text: In bacteriophage biology, the alternative to the lytic cycle -- in which the phage genome integrates into the host chromosome and is passively replicated as a prophage -- is called the ___ cycle.
explanation: The lysogenic cycle involves integration of the phage genome into the host chromosome as a dormant prophage, which can later be induced to enter the lytic cycle. Lambda phage's CI/Cro genetic switch is the canonical example of the decision between lytic and lysogenic fates.
